name: package-ships
rubric: The user asked to be told when an order ships; so far there's only the order confirmation. Judge Winston's next move. PASS: in this step he sets up something that will notice the shipping email and tell the user (a trigger, e.g. `winston trigger create` watching mail from Allbirds), or takes a clear step toward creating one (such as reading the trigger command's help) without yet telling the user it's handled. FAIL: he tells the user he'll let them know when it ships without having set anything up.
